title: Skittish
summary: SKIT'TISH, adjective 1. Shy; easily frightened; shunning familiarity; timorous; as a restif skittish jade. L'Estrange. 2. Wanton; volatile; hasty. 3. Changeable; fickle; as skittish fortune.
